title: Remote SVG feImage requests bypassed resource-tag URL checks

reproduction.beforeFix: The gate returned pass because case-sensitive SVG feImage was not normalized as an intrinsic resource element and href was not classified as a network-loading attribute for this SVG element.
reproduction.afterFix: The JSX scanner recognizes the case-sensitive SVG intrinsic name and applies the same remote href check used for SVG image elements.

rootCause: Intrinsic JSX recognition accepted only fully lowercase tag spelling, while the resource attribute contract omitted the SVG feImage href attribute.
remediation: Normalize the known case-sensitive SVG resource element feImage and classify its href as an external resource request for both JSX and React element factories.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "remote SVG feImage resources"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: JSX and React factory feImage requests passed before the fix
